translation: Ri oodari (wax) ah oo keliya, si aad u dhaaftid xaggooda (si loo hagaajiyo isla markaana la idiin dhaafo) — si loo cafiyo dambiyo dheeraad ah idiinkoo dhaafaya (si loo hagaajiyo idiinkoo dhaafaya)
